name: Statusline
description: Renders a Nomeda status display in the VS Code status bar showing version, cumulative tokens, context-window usage, and 5-hour rolling-window usage.

showVersion.label: Show Version
showVersion.description: When on, the statusline includes the current Nomeda extension version (e.g. v0.42.1) so the user can confirm at a glance which build they are running. When off, the version is hidden. On is the typical default; turn off only if the line is space-constrained on a small monitor.

showCumulativeTokens.label: Show Cumulative Tokens
showCumulativeTokens.description: When on, the statusline displays the total tokens consumed by the active session (input + output across all turns) as a compact number (e.g. 142k). Useful for monitoring spend and noticing runaway turns. Off hides the figure entirely.

showContextPercent.label: Show Context Percent
showContextPercent.description: When on, the statusline displays the fraction of the model's context window currently consumed by the conversation (e.g. 62%). Renders in red at or above the value of Red Threshold Percent as a visual warning. Off hides the figure entirely; the warning highlight only fires when this section is shown.

showRollingWindowPercent.label: Show Rolling Window Percent
showRollingWindowPercent.description: When on, the statusline displays the fraction of the 5-hour rolling rate-limit window consumed (e.g. 5h 41%) when that data is available from the model runtime. Renders in red at or above Red Threshold Percent. Hidden when the runtime payload does not include rolling-window data (early in a session, or accounts without a rolling-window quota).

redThresholdPercent.label: Red Threshold Percent
redThresholdPercent.description: The percent threshold at or above which context-window and rolling-window figures render in red. Default 85 is a soft warning matching the SWT convention. Lower it (e.g. 70) for earlier visual alerts; raise it (e.g. 95) for less aggressive coloring. Applies to both Context Percent and Rolling Window Percent when those are shown.

fallbackToVersionOnly.label: Fallback To Version Only
fallbackToVersionOnly.description: When on, the statusline gracefully degrades to a version-only display when the runtime payload that supplies token/context/rolling-window data is missing or unparseable. When off, all sections fall back to empty if their data source is unavailable, producing a sparse line. On preserves visibility of the Nomeda surface even in degraded states; off favors show nothing rather than incomplete data.
